- I have high priority at w (rank 1) and y (rank 1)
- Most applicants seem to favor y > x > w > z, which suggests competition at y

3. By putting w first, I might have a better chance given my high priority there
4. My risk-seeking nature means I'm comfortable with potential uncertainty or lower probability of matching
